solar_panels.evidence: A dark, regular rectangular grid is on the upper-left roof face of the central house, with a distinct panel pattern against the lighter gray roof.

signals.notes: The house sits in the middle of the lot with a dry, patchy lawn to the west and dense mature trees to the east and south; the roof looks fairly uniform and has a solar array, and the driveway is not clearly visible under the canopy.
